timing.aggregation: Setup kernel separate; search sums sequential launch intervals, never concurrent block clocks. Nominal/late assignment uses legacy state-observation deadline.
timing.preparation: Solver compile_seconds separately includes runtime/module preparation; solve wall time excludes Solver construction and device cleanup.

timing.transfer_clock: Host perf_counter duration of synchronous cuMemcpyHtoD/DtoH calls; excludes host array allocation and context selection. Not CUDA event duration or exclusive device DMA time.
timing.aggregation: Setup kernel separate; search sums sequential launch intervals, never concurrent block clocks. Nominal/late assignment uses legacy state-observation deadline.

scopes.replication: One seeded run; GPU trajectories and checkpoints are not independent replicas.
scopes.work: Steps per trajectory include construction and local search. Candidate counts are distinct instrumented construction/add/remove/swap evaluations aggregated over all 128 trajectories; equal steps are not equal cost.
scopes.first_target: Actual cumulative work at the last below-target and first reached observations, bracketing consecutive complete batches. No exact within-batch hit work or time is inferred.
scopes.censoring: Misses use the nominal deadline for capped time and retain the latest nominal observed work as a lower bound. Late attainment never supplies nominal success or a nominal checkpoint.
scopes.phases: Construction/local step and candidate counters measure work, not exclusive phase duration. No LS time percentage is derived.
scopes.clocks: CUDA events sum sequential kernel launch durations including all phases, state loads/stores. Transfer durations are host wall time around synchronous copy calls, not DMA event time. Search wall time includes observation/instrumentation; clocks are not added as mutually exclusive components.
scopes.setup: Setup/compilation and finalization are separately recorded. solve_wall_seconds_before_cleanup is not a complete process end-to-end runtime.
scopes.uncertainty: Only complete ten-pair capped-time contrasts receive 20,000-resample individual descriptive percentile intervals; coincident target values share a single interval. No automatic significance or universal winner.
